usability_barriers: At 320px/200% app text the expanded menu has an inner scroll region that clips preceding items near the final focus position.
At 844x320/200% app text the urgent-help row is partly cropped in the supplied keyboard-focus-scrolled capture.
Escape leaves card deletion confirmation open while sheet cancellation was recorded using Escape; the card dialog retains a focused Cancel control.
uncertainties: No direct T3 browser actuation in this round.
Shared evidence comes from distinct sessions; route coverage is not a set of five independent runs.
Seven guide DOM samples do not demonstrate patient comprehension.
Space/Enter/Escape activation of every menu/control, true browser zoom, screen-reader use, audible audio, native app behavior, and OS print cancellation were not established.
first_suggestion: Keep the urgent-help row and the currently focused menu item fully visible at short landscape sizes, then align Escape behavior across confirmation dialogs.
